name: Dalton View Day Dig
description:
A logged roman road crosses this area - The specific route passing through Dalton is cataloged as Margary 702aa, which connects the Roman settlement at Wigan to a newly confirmed fort at Burscough
The Route's Path: The road travels northwest out of Wigan, negotiating the steep terrain at Up Holland via a classic Roman zig-zag layout. From Up Holland, it climbs to the high ground running past Dalton and Ashurst Beacon.
The fields you'll be searching are pasture fields and ive attached a video showing the length of the grass.
Its short in many places and tufty in others...
we came here about 3 years ago and it produced multiple silver coins, hammered and a roman fibula as well as many other great bits.
The land has been turned since at least twice.
MAX 40 SPACES £20 per-person, Under 14's free
